answer: Agents deposit bonded stake and, each epoch, evaluate an agreed polynomial whose identity commitment is anchored in a Semaphore zero-knowledge tree. RLN permits only one rate-limited message per domain; duplicate use produces two valid shares of the same epoch Shamir secret, reconstructing and revealing the signing private key from the collision signal. The protocol verifies this proof and instantly slashes collateral, so Sybil identities become costly; a mirror or ridge in transcripts cannot evade nullifier checks.
